text: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 Confidential — Internal Only (Tier 3) Last updated: January 15, 2026 | Owner: Product Management

Strategic Themes for 2026 Real-Time Intelligence : Move from data delivery to actionable insights at the edge. Enterprise Compliance : SOC 2 Type II re-certification, HIPAA readiness, and EU Data Residency. Developer Experience : Cut time-to-first-event from 45 minutes to under 5 minutes. Platform Extensibility : Open connector marketplace and transformation SDK.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Strategic Themes for 2026
Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q1 2026 (January – March)

text: GA Releases Stream Schemas v2 : JSON Schema validation for all stream records. Backward-compatible with v1 streams. Multi-Region Active-Active : Streams replicated across US-East and EU-West with < 100ms cross-region lag. Connector: Salesforce CRM : Change-data-capture for Salesforce objects. Available on Pro and Enterprise tiers.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q1 2026 (January – March) > GA Releases

text: Beta Releases Acme AI Anomaly Detection : ML-based anomaly alerts on stream metrics. Beta opt-in for Enterprise customers.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q1 2026 (January – March) > Beta Releases

text: Deprecations API v1 : Officially deprecated Q1 2026. End-of-life: December 31, 2026. Migration guide: docs.acmecorp.example.com/migrate-v1-v2. HTTP/1.1 for record publishing : HTTP/2 only from Q1 2026. Clients using HTTP/1.1 will receive a deprecation header.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q1 2026 (January – March) > Deprecations
Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q2 2026 (April – June)

text: Planned GA HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) : Healthcare customers can process PHI on Acme DataStream once BAA is signed. Available on Enterprise only. EU Data Residency : Customer data never leaves the EU-West region when the EU Residency flag is set on the organization. Connector Marketplace (v1) : Third-party developers can publish connectors. Initial launch with 5 certified partners. CLI v2 : Acme CLI rewritten in Go. 10× faster cold start. Supports all API v2 operations.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q2 2026 (April – June) > Planned GA

text: Planned Beta Stream Joins : Join two streams on a key within a time window. SQL-like syntax. Beta with design partners. Transformation SDK (Python) : Write custom transformations in Python with local testing support.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q2 2026 (April – June) > Planned Beta
Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q3 2026 (July – September)

text: Planned GA Stream Joins GA : Exit beta; available on Pro and Enterprise. SOC 2 Type II Renewal : Annual audit scheduled for August 2026. Report available to Enterprise customers under NDA. Real-Time Dashboard Builder : Drag-and-drop dashboards powered by stream data. No-code, embeddable. Acme AI Anomaly Detection GA : Production-ready after Q1 beta feedback. Available on Pro and Enterprise.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q3 2026 (July – September) > Planned GA

text: Planned Beta Acme DataSync : Bi-directional sync between two Acme streams with exactly-once delivery semantics. GraphQL API : GraphQL endpoint alongside existing REST API. Read-only initially.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q3 2026 (July – September) > Planned Beta
Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q4 2026 (October – December)

text: Planned GA GraphQL API GA : Full read-write GraphQL support. Transformation SDK GA : Python and TypeScript SDKs with operator certification program. Free Tier Expansion : Increase Free Tier record limit from 1M to 5M/month to accelerate bottom-up adoption.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q4 2026 (October – December) > Planned GA

text: Research / Exploratory Edge Streaming Nodes : Run lightweight ingest nodes at the edge (Cloudflare Workers). Feasibility study ongoing. Acme DataLake Integration : Native export to Apache Iceberg format in customer-owned S3 buckets.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Q4 2026 (October – December) > Research / Exploratory

text: Pricing Changes in 2026 Change Effective Date Details Pro Tier price increase April 1, 2026 From $299/month to $349/month. Existing customers grandfathered until July 1, 2026. Enterprise connector add-on Q2 2026 $50/month per additional connector beyond the 10 included. EU Data Residency premium Q2 2026 20% premium on base subscription for EU-resident accounts. Free Tier record limit increase Q4 2026 1M → 5M records/month.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Pricing Changes in 2026

text: Key Success Metrics for 2026 Grow Enterprise ARR by 40% year-over-year. Achieve NPS of 55+ by Q4 (current: 48). Time-to-first-event: reduce from 45 minutes to 5 minutes . Connector Marketplace: 20 certified connectors by EOY. Developer signups: 50,000 new developer accounts in 2026.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Key Success Metrics for 2026

text: Dependencies and Risks Multi-Region : Dependent on AWS EU-West capacity allocation. Potential delay if AWS TLA capacity is constrained. HIPAA BAA : Legal review may take 6–8 weeks longer than planned. Q2 GA could slip to Q3. Stream Joins : Core engine rewrite required. Engineering estimates carry 30% uncertainty. Roadmap items marked "Planned" are subject to change. GA dates are targets, not commitments. Do not share externally without PM approval.
heading_path: Acme DataStream Product Roadmap — 2026 > Dependencies and Risks
